abilities.critical_failure: The creature falls from the bridge, landing in the ravine 20 feet below.
abilities.effect: All creatures on the bridge must attempt a DC 18 Reflex save.
abilities.name: Perilous Sway
abilities.success: The creature is clumsy 1 until the beginning of its next turn.
abilities.trigger: A Medium or larger creature Strides 10 feet or more in the bridge’s area

abilities.name: Collapse
abilities.text: Each time the decrepit bridge triggers its Perilous Sway after the first, attempt a DC 5 flat check. On a failure, the bridge collapses. All creatures on the bridge fall 20 feet into the ravine, taking falling damage normally.

hazard.description: The 30-foot-long, 10-foot-wide bridge groans under the weight of those who cross it.
hazard.name: Decrepit Bridge

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.
